subject: Data Engineering
title: Infrastructure as Code for Data
description: A quick win: understand Infrastructure as Code for Data.

hook.text: An engineer creates an S3 bucket, a Glue crawler, and a Redshift table. A week later, nobody remembers the config.

buildup.text: Infrastructure as Code defines cloud resources in version-controlled templates instead of manual clicks.

discovery.text: Terraform, Pulumi, and CloudFormation let you provision entire data platforms from a single config file.

twist.text: IaC for data is harder than for web apps. Stateful resources like databases need careful change management.

climax.text: Combining IaC with CI/CD means data infrastructure changes are reviewed, tested, and deployed like code.

punchline.text: If it's not in code, it didn't happen.

quiz.question: What is the main benefit of Infrastructure as Code for data platforms?
options: Resources are version-controlled, reviewable, and reproducible
